messages.content: You are a bounded pre-publication reviewer. Review only the exact diff supplied. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL followed by concrete action items. Check Jenkins-measured identity and mutation semantics, exception ancestry and effect timing, cycle safety, budget safety, regressions, tests/evidence quality, and ticket scope. Do not suggest unrelated refactors.

Review the exact local fix for the two PR #110 findings on base 22fff89040aaef3ae06e215fb5ed6e6310b383b7. Requirements: no-argument List.sort() must sort a true mutable VList receiver in place and return that same identity; a comparison fault or cycle must not partially replace receiver order; closure/boolean sort overloads outside the measured slice must be explicitly refused rather than ignored. IntRange must have distinct immutable provenance, preserve Jenkins-compatible list-like read/equality/display/iteration/reverse/collect behavior, and reject plain/compound/postfix index mutation with catchable UnsupportedOperationException ancestry and measured RHS/read timing. Map and true list indexing must not regress. List-method identity must match measured Jenkins boundaries. Two new Jenkins 2.568.1 cases must be tier-1 PROVEN; scorecard 226/226, 227 seals, corpus admitted197/tier3=30. Exact diff:

+// PR #110 exact-head review closure. IntRange remains list-like for reads,
+// equality and traversal, while every replacement reaches a typed immutable
+// write fault after Jenkins' measured RHS/read/operator timing.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def r = 1..3
+                    def alias = r
+                    def eachSeen = []
+                    r.each { eachSeen << it }
+                    def forSeen = []
+                    for (v in 3..1) { forSeen << v }
+                    def reversed = r.reverse()
+                    reversed[0] = 9
+                    def collected = r.collect { it * 10 }
+                    collected[0] = 8
+
+                    echo "range:${r}:${r[0]}:${r[-1]}:${r[5]}:${r == [1, 2, 3]}"
+                    echo "iteration:${eachSeen}:${forSeen}"
+                    echo "fresh:${reversed}:${collected}:${r}"
+
+                    def events = []
+                    def rhs = { events << 'plain-rhs'; 9 }
+                    def compoundRhs = { events << 'compound-rhs'; 2 }
+                    try { r[0] = rhs() } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) { events << 'plain-caught' }
+                    try { r[0] += compoundRhs() } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) { events << 'compound-caught' }
+                    try { r[0]++ } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) { events << 'postfix-caught' }
+                    try { alias[-1] = 7 } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) { events << 'alias-caught' }
+                    try { r.sort() } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) { events << 'sort-caught' }
+                    try { r[-4] } catch (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException ignored) { events << 'negative-oob-caught' }
+
+                    echo "writes:${events}:${r}:${alias}"
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// PR #110 exact-head review closure. The no-copy sort overload mutates and
+// returns one receiver identity; a cyclic comparison faults before replacement.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def xs = [2, 1, 2]
+                    def alias = xs
+                    def sorted = xs.sort()
+                    sorted[0] = 9
+                    echo "identity:${xs}:${alias}:${sorted}"
+
+                    def left = [null]
+                    def right = [null]
+                    left[0] = left
+                    right[0] = right
+                    def cyclic = [left, right, 1]
+                    try {
+                        cyclic.sort()
+                        echo 'cycle:unexpected'
+                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {
+                        echo "cycle:${cyclic[0] == left}:${cyclic[1] == right}:${cyclic[2] == 1}"
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
